providers.name: Higgsfield
providers.useWhen: free-trial/unlimited allowance or credits are available without new spend
providers.skipWhen: trial unavailable, allowance exhausted, or generation would require unapproved spend

providers.name: Runway
providers.useWhen: connected workspace exposes an eligible video model
providers.skipWhen: availableVideoModels is empty or generation requires unapproved plan change

providers.name: HeyGen
providers.useWhen: free generation allowance exists and requested format is natively supported
providers.skipWhen: free allowance exhausted or provider can only produce a single-speaker substitution for a multi-character story

rotationRules: Check provider availability before every generation attempt.
If a provider is capped, rate-limited, unavailable, or cannot satisfy the requested format, skip it automatically and try the next provider.
Never substitute static portraits, slideshows, Ken Burns motion, or one-speaker talking-head output for required full animation.
Do not incur new charges, start paid subscriptions, or accept paid trials without user authorization.
For story posts require animated characters, visible actions, coherent story-matched environments, natural non-repetitive dialogue, and no accidental text.
For brain-rot posts require original fully animated characters, expressive full-body motion, coherent environment interaction, and no accidental text.
Only intentional captions/subtitles/title cards may contain text.
If no provider can currently generate a compliant video without new spend, do not post an inferior fallback; recheck provider availability on the next automated attempt.
